notes:
• Workout score: calculated from your sets, last time and records, with the reasons shown. No AI key needed.
• Quicker start: setup in 4 steps, a weekly target that matches the days you can train, and today's workout first on Home.
• Live workout: one tap for warm-ups, a note button after Pain, and a workout left open ends at your last set.
• Smoother app: animated lists, swipe to delete with Undo, drag to reorder plan exercises, and larger-text fixes.
• Arabic: day names shown in full, and messages follow the app language.
